class.name: E3DRenderingServer
class.brief_description: RID based server of E3D model instances.
class.description: Singleton with an API similar to [RenderingServer]. An instance is created with [method instance_create], set up with the [code]instance_set_*[/code] methods and [method instance_attach_object_instance_id], and built with [method instance_build]. The [enum Instancer] of an instance selects how it is built: [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] renders every submodel as a [RenderingServer] instance without creating any nodes (used for scenery models), [constant INSTANCER_NODES] and [constant INSTANCER_EDITABLE_NODES] build a [Node3D]/[MeshInstance3D]/[SpotLight3D] tree under the attached node. [code]E3DModelInstance[/code] is a node client of this server. [RenderingServer] instances are freed when the singleton is deleted. Scenery placements are registered with [method instance_register] instead: [SceneryStreamingServer] builds them only while its camera is within their visibility range of the chunk they fall into, and clears them again when it leaves.

method.name: environment_set_wind
method.description: The wind every particle emitter drifts with: [param strength] in metres per second along the unit [param direction]. Separate so that the direction can grow a vertical component without the signature changing. Pushed by [code]MaszynaEnvironmentNode[/code] together with the time of day and the light level.

method.name: instance_attach_object_instance_id
method.description: The [Node3D], by instance id, that [constant INSTANCER_NODES] and [constant INSTANCER_EDITABLE_NODES] build their node tree under. [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instances report it as their owner (e.g. for picking in the editor). [code]0[/code] detaches it. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_build
method.description: Builds (or rebuilds) the content of the [param instance]. Materials are resolved with the callable set by [method material_set_resolver].

method.name: instance_create
method.description: Creates an empty instance; set it up with the [code]instance_set_*[/code] methods and [method instance_attach_object_instance_id], then call [method instance_build]. [param instance_kind] says what the placement is, in the words a [code].scn[/code] uses for it. It is given here rather than through a setter because it cannot be changed once the instance is built: the smoke density it selects is baked into every particle emitter of the model - its process material, its particle budget and its spawn rate. A client that has to change it frees the instance and creates it again.

method.name: instance_free
method.description: Frees the [param instance] with its [RenderingServer] instances or generated nodes.

method.name: instance_get_aabb
method.description: The bounds of every mesh of the model, in the model's space.

method.name: instance_get_attached_node
method.description: The instance id of the node attached with [method instance_attach_object_instance_id] - the one a node tree is built under - or [code]0[/code] for none, or for one that is gone.

method.name: instance_get_data_path
method.description: The directory the instance's model and textures are read from.

method.name: instance_get_model
method.description: The model the instance draws.

method.name: instance_get_model_filename
method.description: The model file of a registered instance ([method instance_register]); empty for one created from a model ([method instance_create]).

method.name: instance_get_opaque_meshes
method.description: The instance ids of the [MeshInstance3D] nodes of the instance's opaque submodels - what the original draws into its pick buffer; a translucent submodel is left out. Empty for an instance not built as nodes.

method.name: instance_get_skins
method.description: The skins the instance's model is drawn with.

method.name: instance_get_submodel_transform
method.description: The submodel's transform in the model, through every parent, without any pose.

method.name: instance_get_transform
method.description: Where the instance stands ([method instance_set_transform], [method instance_register]).

method.name: instance_has_submodel
method.description: Whether the model has the submodel.

method.name: instance_intersect_segment
method.description: Where the segment [param from]..[param to] (world space) first meets the meshes of the instance: [code]{position, distance}[/code], the distance measured from [param from]. Empty when it misses, or when the instance is hidden or not built (not streamed in).

method.name: instance_register
method.description: Registers a scenery model placement for streaming instead of building it right away. Nothing is loaded or built until [SceneryStreamingServer]'s camera comes within [param range_end] of the chunk the [param transform] falls into; the instance is cleared again when the camera leaves. [param range_end] of [code]0[/code] (a scenery node that declares no range) means the global draw distance. The model is loaded on the streaming worker thread with the callable set by [method model_set_loader]. Without a streaming camera a registered instance is never built. Free it with [method instance_free] like any other instance.

method.name: instance_set_emission_energy
method.description: The self-illumination energy of every emissive material of the instance.

method.name: instance_set_instancer
method.description: Builds the instance again with another instancer, keeping the RID and everything set on it.

method.name: instance_set_layer_mask
method.description: Render layers of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance.

method.name: instance_set_lights_dimmed
method.description: Light name to dimmed: a dimmed light shows its "_xon" submodel instead of "_on" when it has one, and its spotlight ([constant INSTANCER_NODES]) shines at [param multiplier] of its energy.

method.name: instance_set_lights_state
method.description: Light name to enabled state; shows the "on" or the "off" submodels of the model's lights (and the spotlights of [constant INSTANCER_NODES]).

method.name: instance_set_material_overlay
method.description: Draws [param material] over every submodel of the instance (an outline, a tint); [code]null[/code] for none. Kept while the instance is streamed out and in again.

method.name: instance_set_node_transform
method.description: Where the model sits in the attached node - a node tree built under it is placed there.

method.name: instance_set_options
method.description: Material lookup path and skins, submodels excluded from rendering, forced alpha blending and the largest texture size its materials load, [code]0[/code] for the project's [code]maszyna/import/dds_max_texture_size[/code] (see [code]E3DModelInstance[/code]). Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_scenario
method.description: Scenario of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_smoke_intensity
method.description: Spawn rate multiplier of every particle emitter of the instance, as the engine state drives it. [code]1.0[/code] is the emitter template's own rate - what a scenery chimney keeps. An [constant INSTANCE_KIND_DYNAMIC] instance starts at [code]0.0[/code] and spawns nothing until its client sets the rate. Only the rate: nothing here may reach a particle that is already in the air. Both the process material's colour and its initial colour ramp are read on every frame, so driving either of them from the engine state steps the whole plume down together instead of letting it thin out.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_emission_energy
method.description: The self-illumination energy of a submodel, by name, and of everything under it, kept across rebuilds; below 0 gives it the instance's own again - one cab of a low-poly interior lit by its cab light.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_material_override
method.description: Draws a submodel, by name, with [param material] instead of its own.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_poses
method.description: Poses submodels, by name, on top of their own transform, kept across rebuilds.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_visible
method.description: Shows or hides a submodel, by name, kept across rebuilds.

method.name: instance_set_transform
method.description: Global transform of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance. A node tree follows its attached node instead.

method.name: instance_set_visibility_range
method.description: Limits the visibility range of all submodels of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance, [code]0[/code] - no limit. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_visible
method.description: Visibility of an [constant INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance.

method.name: material_set_resolver
method.description: Called as [code]material_resolver(submodel: E3DSubModel, data_path: String, skins: PackedStringArray, translucency: Translucency, max_texture_size: int) -> Material[/code] for every rendered submodel. Set by [code]MaterialManager[/code].

method.name: model_load
method.description: The model of a file, loaded once and shared by every instance of it.

method.name: model_set_loader
method.description: Called as [code]model_loader(data_path: String, filename: String) -> E3DModel[/code] on the streaming worker thread, for instances registered with [method instance_register] that enter the camera's range. The result is memoized per path. Set by [code]E3DModelManager[/code].

method.name: smoke_get_statistics
method.description: Number of particle emitters the server owns ([code]total[/code]) and how many of them are currently built ([code]built[/code]). A scenery emitter is built only while it is streamed in.

method.name: smoke_rebuild
method.description: Builds every instance's particle emitters again - what the source resolver makes them of has changed. The server does it itself when [code]maszyna/smoke/enabled[/code] or a smoke distance changes.

method.name: smoke_set_source_resolver
method.description: Called as [code]smoke_source_resolver(template_name: String, owner: InstanceKind) -> Dictionary[/code] with the keys [code]process_material[/code], [code]mesh[/code], [code]amount[/code], [code]lifetime[/code] and [code]aabb[/code], when an emitter is built. An empty dictionary leaves the emitter unbuilt. Set by [code]SmokeSourceLibrary[/code], which reads the templates from the game's [code]data/[/code] directory.

constants.constant: Renders submodels as [RenderingServer] instances, without nodes.
Builds an internal node tree under the attached node.
Builds a node tree under the attached node, editable in the editor.

A static [code]node ... model[/code] of a scenery - a chimney, a cooling tower, a road vehicle standing as a prop. This is what a placement registered with [method instance_register] always is. Its smoke follows [code]maszyna/rendering/smoke_density_static[/code].
Part of a [code]dynamic[/code], which is a vehicle. Its smoke follows [code]maszyna/rendering/smoke_density_dynamic[/code].
The submodel is drawn as its material says: opaque, or cut out at the alpha threshold.
Alpha-blended - a forced submodel drawn as nodes.
Opaque whatever its texture's alpha - a forced submodel of the optimized instancer, which never draws in the alpha pass.
